standard: shampoo-classification-v1.6.1 candidate (lane-a scrubbed copy); not a locked policy id

formulaBlock.normalization: ID-2: 'Aqua/Water/Eau' one entry; colour entries 'CI 16035/Red 40', 'CI 19140/Yellow 5' one entry each; 39 normalized entries; normalized positions

cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the amphoteric Cocamidopropyl Betaine @2, followed by mild anionics Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate @3, Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate @4, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate @5. Any order among them still yields C6 low. Counter-signal: three mild anionic routes (breadth).

conditioningLevel.rationale: high by C2: early (prominent) silicone Amodimethicone/Morpholinomethyl Silsesquioxane Copolymer @18, cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @16, pearlizing route Glycol Distearate @6, deliberate humectant Glycerin @17; plus Sunflower Seed Oil @15 and Quaternium-95 @26. Counter-signal: silicone, guar and oil all sit after Piroctone Olamine @12 and peptides @7/@10 (plausibly sub-1 % each); neighbor moderate.

reset: mild anionic Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate @3, Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate @4, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate @5
excluded: PPG-2 Hydroxyethyl Cocamide @19 (alkanolamide thickener, not deposition)

skipped: w_line_skipped:Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1@7 (ii) alkanolamide-type thickener PPG-2 Hydroxyethyl Cocamide@19 listed after it before the cap
wLineRecord.note: Benzoic Acid @21: (i) surfactants @2-5 before it; (ii) nothing of the structurant classes between @22 and @36. Sunflower Seed Oil @15 < 21 is therefore material.

weightPotential.counterevidence: All deposition (oil @15, guar @16, silicone copolymer @18, Quaternium-95 @26) sits after a capped active (Piroctone Olamine @12) and peptide actives, so each is plausibly sub-1 %; the alkanolamide @19 after those actives shows the list below about 1 % is not in descending order. The oil is material only because the W-line is pushed to @21.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: W-RICH holds for weight: material payload_lipid Sunflower Seed Oil @15 (before W-line @21) converging with a persistent amino-silicone copolymer @18 and cationic guar @16; reset is limited (C6 low mild chassis, resetCapacity weak), so the rich route of the high anchor holds; the convergence route (silicone + cationic polymer + cationic conditioner + material lipid) points the same way.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate would need reset to offset the converging deposition, which a mild C6 chassis does not do; the case for moderate rests only on unknown (probably small) amounts.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: every deposition route is in the probable sub-1 % zone; material lipid status depends on the alkanolamide skip
weightPotential.rationale: high: W-RICH with limited reset (6.7 W-RICH, W-LINE) plus converging persistent families (6.6); confidence moderate because amounts are plausibly small (neighbor moderate).

careDirection.limitation: formula-only; no protein or humectant cluster distinguishing repair or moisture

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Peptide/flavonoid actives (Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1 @7, Oleanolic Acid @8, Apigenin @9, Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3 @10, Trifolium Pratense Flower Extract @11) are a hair-loss-type complex and never a focus route (F5); Piroctone Olamine @12 is a recognized dandruff active.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind pass: claim direction null; scalp_active is formula-compatible only with dandruff positioning; provisional general.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible.

usageRole.rationale: provisional regular; treatment fires only with a qualifying dandruff claim (U3); hair-loss positioning never fires treatment (F5, U3).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: provisional not_targeted (no positioning visible). CSA formula half: no prominent E4 comfort route (no Panthenol/Allantoin/Bisabolol etc.), but prominent humectant/refatting routes Glycerin @17 and Sunflower Seed Oil @15 meet CSA. An S-SENSITIVE gate would fail for lack of a comfort route.

dandruffSupport.rationale: supported: Piroctone Olamine @12 in a complete formula (Section 11).

surfactantClasses.c4: no defining anionic; C6 earliest prominent = Cocamidopropyl Betaine @2

uncertainties: weightPotential high vs moderate: the W-RICH rich route is formally met (material oil @15, persistent silicone/cationic, weak reset) but every route is in the probable sub-1 % zone; recorded high at moderate confidence, neighbor moderate (P0 heavier side).
Quaternium-95 read as cationic_conditioner by name; immaterial to the band.
